title: Austin: New Service Car, Firefighters, Tax Refund
summary:
*   A permit was granted to Jas. E. Ryones to operate a "service car," an early form of public transportation.
*   Two new hosemen, A. J. Hamilton and Davis Cotell, were appointed to the city's Fire Department.
*   A property tax refund was approved for Doole & Sons and David Doole Jr., correcting a double assessment on their personal property.

SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:
Austin, Texas, January 20, 1920.

The Council was called to order by the Mayor. Roll call showed the following members
present: Mayor Yett, Councilmen Alford, Graham, Haynes and Ward, 5; absent, none.

Service car
Jas. E. Ryones

The application of Jas. E. Ryones to operate a service car was granted by the following
vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen Alford, Graham, Haynes and Ward, 5; nays, none.

Fixing Value
M. K. & T. L. & T. Co.
$36,977.00

Councilman Haynes moved that the assessment of the M.K.& T. Land & Town Company’s property
be placed at $36,977.00, Value as fixed by the Board of Equalization for the year 1918.
Motion carried by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen Alford, Graham, Haynes
and Ward, 5; nays, none.

The Council then adjourned.
Jac. D. Formsby, City Clerk.

REGULAR MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:

Austin, Texas, January 22, 1920.

The Council was called to order by the Mayor. Roll call showed the following members
present: Mayor Yett, Councilmen Alford, Graham, Haynes and Ward, 5; absent, none.
The minutes of the last meeting were read and unanimously adopted.

Floyd Smith
Elect. Sign

The application of Floyd Smith to erect a new electrical sign at No. 400 Congress Avenue
was referred to the city electrician.
Upon the recommendation of C. L. Woodward, Chief of the Fire Appt.
A. J. Hamilton
& Davis Cotell
Firemen

Department, Councilman Alford nominated A. J. Hamilton and Davis Cotell to be hosemen in
the Austin Fire Department to succeed Harper Nations and August Von Rosenberg. Nominations
were confirmed by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen Graham, Haynes and
Ward, 4; nays, none – Councilman Alford present but not voting.
Councilman Haynes introduced the following resolution: BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: That whereas, the statement of Fred Sterzing, Tax Collector,
hereRefund $
Doole & Sons
David Doole Jr.

with attached, shows a double rendition of personal property for the year 1919, one by
Doole & Sons and one by David Doole, Jr., and that they are entitled to a refund of $8.42
on one of said renditions, Therefore, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
AUSTIN, TEXAS: That the City Clerk be instructed to issue a warrant for that amount to
Doole & Sons out of the General Contingent Fund, and that the Assessor and Collector be
authorized to cancel one of the assessments on his rolls and to take credit therefor.

The above resolution was adopted by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen
Alford, Graham, Haynes and Ward, 5; nays, none.
The Council then recessed.
